reason: Article 9 of the EU AI Act establishes the scope and definitions for the regulation, including what constitutes an AI system. It does not contain any specific obligations related to access control, authentication, or authorization.

Article 15 outlines the obligations for high-risk AI systems, focusing on the requirements for the provider to ensure the system is compliant with the regulation. It does not address specific technical security controls like SSO, MFA, or access reviews.

Article 17 details the obligations for providers of high-risk AI systems to implement a quality management system. This is a broad governance requirement and does not specifically mandate the technical access control measures mentioned in the control statement.
